instruction.name: x86mfflag
instruction.description: Read selected x86 flags from EFLAGS, as determined by mask, and pack them into rd.

operands.name: mask
operands.description: flag-selection mask (0x3f selects CF, PF, AF, ZF, SF, OF)

latencies.notes: Slope method (--unroll 100000, --unroll2 200000), median of three runs; 3 cycles of flag-helper latency subtracted where the chain closes through x86mtflag/x86mfflag. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86mfflag $r12, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r13, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r14, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r15, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r16, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r17, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r18, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r19, 0x3f
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 0x3f
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 0x3f' --asm 'x86mfflag $r12, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r13, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r14, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r15, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r16, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r17, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r18, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r19, 0x3f'
